clue.text: Contemplate changing both date and time

indicators.note: changing tells us to alter the order of the letters of the two words that follow

explanation.surface: Someone thinks about altering both the date and the time of an appointment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'both' just bundles the two words; DATE and TIME together are the eight letters rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: To meditate is to think deeply, a straight synonym for contemplate as a verb.

clue.text: No Green Party would have such a monster in it

indicators.note: would have ... in it says the clue's own words hold the letters inside them

explanation.surface: A political musing that the Greens would never harbour such a beast in their ranks.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across the end of 'No' and the start of 'Green'.
explanation.definitionFit: An ogre is a man-eating giant of folklore, a kind of monster.

clue.text: A man of stone

definitions.meaning: an opaque, usually red, variety of quartz used as a semi-precious stone

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a boy's name and a mineral, so each half of the clue defines it.

clue.text: A large number turned up at Elaine's home

indicators.note: in a down clue turned up means the word for a large number is read from bottom to top

parts.note: lots means a large number

explanation.surface: A big crowd arrived at the house of a woman called Elaine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned up' makes STOL from LOTS. Elaine is the Lily Maid of Arthurian legend, Elaine of Astolat.
explanation.definitionFit: In Arthurian legend and Tennyson's poems, the castle town of Astolat is where Elaine lived.

clue.text: People driving cattle without hesitation

indicators.note: without is used in its old sense of outside, so the cattle word wraps round the hesitation word

parts.note: steers are young castrated bulls, so cattle
er is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: Drovers move a herd along without pausing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking', but here it means outside: STEER(ER)S.
explanation.definitionFit: Steerers are those who guide a vehicle, that is people at the wheel doing the driving.

clue.text: These days only males require time to find accommodation

parts.note: AD, anno Domini, marks the present era, these days
just means only
men are males

explanation.surface: A complaint that nowadays only men need time to settle into lodgings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accommodation' looks like lodgings but is meant as adaptation or compromise.
explanation.definitionFit: An accommodation in the sense of a compromise or adaptation is an adjustment.

clue.text: A river always going in different directions

indicators.note: going in says the word for always is placed inside the directions

parts.note: S and N, south and north, are two different compass directions
ever means always

explanation.surface: A river that keeps twisting this way and that.
explanation.definitionFit: The Severn is Britain's longest river, flowing through Wales and England.

clue.text: Deep green?

parts.note: the deep is a poetic name for the sea, and green can mean grass, so the phrase hints at a plant growing under the sea

explanation.definitionFit: Seagrass is a flowering marine plant forming green meadows on the sea bed.

clue.text: Reflected it was no longer properly organised

indicators.note: reflected, as in a mirror, means the little word that follows is turned backwards

parts.note: someone who died was no longer living

explanation.surface: Someone muses that something was no longer in proper order.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reflected' looks like 'thought about', but turns IT into TI.
explanation.definitionFit: Something tidied has been put in order, made neat and properly organised.

clue.text: Leather shroud

definitions.meaning: an animal skin used for leather
to shroud is to cover or conceal

explanation.definitionFit: One word means both an animal's skin and the act of concealing, a noun and a verb.

clue.text: Somehow secures top wages

indicators.note: somehow tells us the letters are put together in some other order

explanation.surface: Someone manages to get the highest pay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wages' is the verb, as in wages war, not pay.
explanation.definitionFit: To wage a campaign or a war is to carry it on, as one prosecutes it.

clue.text: He could well make a good bowler

definitions.text: He could well make a good bowler

parts.words: He could well make a good bowler
parts.note: a bowler is a round hard felt hat, so the person meant is a hat-maker, not a cricketer

explanation.definitionFit: A hatter makes hats, and a bowler is a hard felt hat with a rounded crown.

clue.text: Their patrons must expect to get needled!

definitions.text: Their patrons must expect to get needled!

parts.words: Their patrons must expect to get needled!
parts.note: needled usually means annoyed, but here the customers are literally pricked by needles while having skin decorated

explanation.definitionFit: Tattooists ink designs into skin with needles, so their customers are needled.

clue.text: Encouraging article on taking chances

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
betting is taking chances with money

explanation.surface: A heartening article about gambling.
explanation.definitionFit: Abetting means helping or encouraging someone, usually in wrongdoing.

clue.text: Stand for the Scripture reading

parts.note: read as a piece of church furniture: the stand on which the Bible rests for the lesson

explanation.definitionFit: A lectern is a sloping desk-stand from which the Bible lesson is read in church.

clue.text: Thinking to put spirit into a worker

parts.note: rum is a spirit
into gives IN, read as a plain piece placed between the spirit and the worker
an ant is a worker insect

explanation.surface: Musing on whether to give a labourer some liquor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'into' reads like a container signal, but it simply gives IN, so the pieces run side by side. 'Thinking' is an adjective: a ruminant mind chews things over.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruminant means meditative or contemplative, from chewing the cud, so thinking.

clue.text: Vilify equally awkward peers

parts.note: as means equally, as in as good

indicators.note: awkward tells us the letters of the peers word are clumsily rearranged

explanation.surface: A call to slander lords who are just as clumsy.
explanation.definitionFit: To asperse is to cast slurs on someone, a formal synonym for vilify.

clue.text: Industrial action that's quite out of the ordinary

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both going on strike and being remarkable or eye-catching.

clue.text: The senior magistrate preparing a report

indicators.note: preparing tells us the letters are worked up into a new form

explanation.surface: A top judge is drafting a report.
explanation.definitionFit: In ancient Rome a praetor was a senior magistrate ranking just below the consuls.

clue.text: The reporter may get in late

parts.note: late means former, as in the late chairman

explanation.surface: A journalist might arrive at the office late.
explanation.walkthrough: 'late' looks like tardy but means former; the reporter is an informant, not a journalist.
explanation.definitionFit: An informer reports on others to the authorities, so a reporter of a kind.

clue.text: A religious lady — one in company representing the Roman Church

definitions.note: a phrase describing the Pope's envoy; the answer is the noun for that envoy

parts.note: a nun is a religious woman

indicators.note: in says the one goes inside company

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A nun and a companion stand for the Catholic Church.
explanation.definitionFit: A nuncio is a papal ambassador, an envoy representing the Holy See abroad.

clue.text: Official statement concerning volte-face

parts.note: re means concerning, about
a volte-face is an about-turn

explanation.surface: A formal declaration about a U-turn.
explanation.definitionFit: A return is an official report, such as a tax return or election return.

clue.text: A weapon in need of repair, being faulty

indicators.note: being faulty suggests the letters are out of order

explanation.surface: A sword needs mending because it is defective.
explanation.definitionFit: A rapier is a slender, sharp-pointed sword used for thrusting.

clue.text: Hide an MP in trouble for producing cannabis

indicators.note: trouble tells us the letters are stirred up into a new order

explanation.surface: Concealing a politician who is in trouble for growing drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' belongs to the letters being rearranged, leaving 'trouble' alone as the signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Indian hemp is the cannabis plant, Cannabis sativa indica, the source of the drug.

clue.text: Following a vigil

definitions.meaning: a watch kept over a body before burial

explanation.definitionFit: The word means the trail behind something, hence following, and a night watch over the dead.

clue.text: Run set up for an animal

indicators.note: in a down clue set up means the word is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: to flow is to run, as water does

explanation.surface: Establishing a route for a creature.
explanation.definitionFit: The wolf is a wild carnivorous mammal of the dog family.

clue.text: The way to appear in the right — take notice!

indicators.note: to appear in says the way goes inside the right

parts.note: a lien is a legal right to hold property until a debt is paid
ST is short for street, a way

explanation.surface: Advice on how to be in the right, ending with a sharp command to pay attention.
explanation.definitionFit: Listen as a command means pay attention, the same as take notice.

clue.text: Left the country, but not by sea

parts.note: over means left, remaining
land means a country

explanation.surface: Someone left their country but avoided going by ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Left' looks like departed but means remaining, as in leftover.
explanation.definitionFit: Overland means travelling across land, so by road or rail rather than by sea.
